description: Create a vehicle maintenance tracking spreadsheet for a 2019 Toyota Camry (current mileage: 47,500). The spreadsheet must log 5 past service records with columns: Service Date, Odometer Reading, Service Type, and Service Cost. Add summary calculations including: Total Maintenance Cost (SUM), Average Cost per Service (AVERAGE), Total Miles Driven (calculation), and Cost per 1,000 Miles (formula). Include a 'Next Service Alert' section with days until next oil change due. Apply proper formatting: dates as MM/DD/YYYY, costs as currency with $ symbol, mileage with comma separators. Save as vehicle_maintenance.xlsx in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/.
